snippet.description:
What You Should Play This Weekend — Labor Day Edition

It's a stacked release week, so here are 5 games worth your time this weekend, ranked honestly by whether they're actually worth playing.

🗡️ Onimusha: Way of the Sword (Metacritic 85) — PS5, Xbox, PC, Switch 2
Capcom's samurai series returns after 20 years. Sekiro/Nioh energy with brutal, precise swordplay.

🚀 Orbitals (Metacritic 82) — Switch 2
A two-player co-op puzzle adventure with GameShare support, so your friend doesn't need to own it to play.

🌙 Crimson Moon (Metacritic 72) — PS5, Xbox, PC
Souls-inspired gothic co-op action. Good bones, rough interface. Worth watching, maybe not worth buying day one.

🏪 Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault (Metacritic 77) — PS5, Xbox, Switch 2, PC
Run a shop by day, raid dungeons by night. Now fully 3D and out of Early Access.

🧛 The Blood of Dawnwalker (Metacritic 83) — PS5, Xbox, PC
From the studio founded by The Witcher 3's director. Live as human by day, vampire by night.

Let me know in the comments which one you're playing first!

👉 Subscribe for a new weekend lineup every week.
